title: Initializing Tooltips
ques: Explain how Bootstrap **Tooltips** function and provide both the HTML trigger and the JavaScript initialization snippet required to activate them.

answer.content:
<!-- HTML Trigger Element -->
<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-toggle="tooltip" data-bs-placement="top" data-bs-title="Export data as CSV">
  Export
</button>

<script>
// Tooltips are opt-in for performance; they must be initialized via JavaScript!
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const tooltipTriggerList = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]');
  const tooltipList = [...tooltipTriggerList].map(el => new bootstrap.Tooltip(el));
});
</script>

explanation: Bootstrap tooltips are powered by Popper.js and must be initialized via JavaScript by querying all elements matching `[data-bs-toggle="tooltip"]`.

title: Configuring Popovers
ques: Demonstrate how to configure a Bootstrap **Popover** with title and dismissible behavior on next click.

answer.content:
<!-- HTML Trigger with data-bs-trigger="focus" for auto-dismissal on blur -->
<button type="button" class="btn btn-lg btn-danger" data-bs-toggle="popover" data-bs-trigger="focus" title="Security Notice" data-bs-content="Your password must contain at least 12 characters including uppercase and numbers.">
  Dismissible Popover
</button>

<script>
// Initialize popovers via JS
const popoverTriggerList = document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-toggle="popover"]');
const popoverList = [...popoverTriggerList].map(el => new bootstrap.Popover(el));
</script>

explanation: Popovers offer richer content than tooltips. `data-bs-trigger="focus"` enables auto-dismissal when users click outside the trigger button.
